statements.proposition: This change introduces no breaking API changes (no public name removed or renamed, no public signature changed).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Ticked checkbox, so a claim. Whitespace-insensitive diff shows the non-player changes are formatting/lint fixes (prettier-style commas, let->const, loop var scoping); no export removed or renamed and no public signature changed. Player.play keeps signature Promise<void>; its behaviour changes only in that an AbortError now resolves instead of rejecting, which I judge not to be an API break. Behavioural compatibility in general was not tested.
evidence: gh api pulls/4166/files: 10 modified files, none removed/added
git diff -w --ignore-blank-lines base..head --stat: only 7 files have non-whitespace changes; spectrogram/fft/worker hunks are formatting (trailing commas, line wrapping, let->const, 'for (let i')
grep of changed lines for export/public/static: only 'export default WindowedSpectrogramPlugin' and 'export default Timer' with trailing whitespace/newline changes
